name: Greenhouse
description: Greenhouse is an applicant tracking and hiring platform built around structured hiring, offering interview kits, candidate scorecards, a candidate portal (MyGreenhouse), fraud detection/identity verification tooling (Real Talent), and 100+ pre-built integrations, priced through a custom quote across three named plan tiers.
best_for: Companies that want a dedicated, structured-hiring applicant tracking system rather than a lightweight hiring module bundled inside a broader HRIS.
features: Structured hiring workflows with interview kits and candidate scorecards
MyGreenhouse candidate portal for real-time application status and job alerts
Real Talent tooling for candidate fraud detection and identity verification
Voice AI, a two-way voice-based interview tool positioned as an alternative to resume-only screening
100+ pre-built integrations for background checks, assessments, HRIS, and other hiring-adjacent tools
Three named plan tiers (Core, Plus, Pro) that scale structure and complexity features with hiring needs
Mobile app (Greenhouse Recruiting) for approving job openings/offers, reviewing candidates, and giving interview feedback on the go
pros: Purpose-built for structured, data-driven hiring rather than being a hiring module bolted onto a broader HR suite
Customers can upgrade plan tiers as hiring volume or organizational complexity grows
Large pre-built integration marketplace (100+) for background checks, assessments, and other recruiting tools
cons: No pricing is published on greenhouse.com; a plan recommendation and price both require talking to a Greenhouse expert
As a dedicated ATS, it does not include payroll, benefits administration, or broader HRIS record-keeping the way an all-in-one HR platform does

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Positioned as bringing structure to hiring. No published price; requires a custom quote.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Positioned as optimizing hiring operations. No published price; requires a custom quote.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Positioned for managing hiring complexity at larger scale. No published price; requires a custom quote.

alternatives.name: BambooHR
alternatives.description: An HRIS for small and mid-sized businesses that includes an applicant tracking system alongside core HR record-keeping.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller companies wanting hiring bundled into a broader HRIS rather than a standalone dedicated ATS.

alternatives.name: Rippling
alternatives.description: A modular workforce platform whose Rippling Recruiting product adds applicant tracking as an add-on to its core HRIS.
alternatives.best_for: Companies already using Rippling for HR/IT that want to add recruiting rather than adopt a separate best-of-breed ATS.

alternatives.name: Gusto
alternatives.description: A payroll, benefits, and HR platform with built-in hiring and onboarding tools such as custom offer letters and checklists.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting basic hiring/onboarding included with payroll rather than a dedicated structured-hiring ATS.
